scope: UX-001..UX-018, UX-024, UX-041..UX-049, UX-111, UX-112; isolated Chromium; loopback fixture API

rows.acceptance: Mouse, keyboard and touch scrolling work. Idle bars fade. CLI whitespace stays exact.

checks.name: mouse, keyboard, and idle scrollbar behavior
checks.limitation: Fixture verifies mouse wheel, PageDown, touch gesture, and idle scrollbar fade; no assistive-technology or owner visual certification.

checks.name: Chromium touch gesture scrolls the conversation surface
checks.limitation: Fixture verifies mouse wheel, PageDown, touch gesture, and idle scrollbar fade; no assistive-technology or owner visual certification.

rows.limitation: Fixture verifies mouse wheel, PageDown, touch gesture, and idle scrollbar fade; no assistive-technology or owner visual certification.

rows.acceptance: No horizontal sidebar or page scroll at agreed desktop widths. Long CLI lines remain copy-exact.

checks.name: raw CLI line copy stays exact while page bounds remain contained
checks.limitation: Fixture verifies exact CLI text and clipboard whitespace plus 390px horizontal containment; no wider viewport matrix.

rows.limitation: Fixture verifies exact CLI text and clipboard whitespace plus 390px horizontal containment; no wider viewport matrix.

rows.acceptance: Caret absent; account menu remains keyboard reachable.

checks.name: account entry has no caret and returns focus after Escape
checks.limitation: Fixture verifies keyboard account entry/Escape focus and visible identity; browser caret and assistive-technology certification remain separate.

rows.limitation: Fixture verifies keyboard account entry/Escape focus and visible identity; browser caret and assistive-technology certification remain separate.

rows.acceptance: Firewall opens firewall profile. Rename synchronizes header. Editing and documents remain accessible.

checks.name: profile rename updates selected header and leaves other coworker unchanged
checks.limitation: Fixture verifies profile rename/header synchronization and peer identity in local storage; no multi-user sync.

rows.limitation: Fixture verifies profile rename/header synchronization and peer identity in local storage; no multi-user sync.

rows.acceptance: Row matches reference structure; opens by mouse and keyboard without clipping.

checks.name: reaction row opens by keyboard and pointer without clipping
checks.limitation: Fixture verifies pointer/keyboard reaction row navigation and viewport bounds; no visual reference diff.

rows.limitation: Fixture verifies pointer/keyboard reaction row navigation and viewport bounds; no visual reference diff.

rows.acceptance: Select A then B leaves only B. Selecting B clears it. Reload preserves result without losing messages.

checks.name: one reaction replaces, clears, survives reload, and preserves messages
checks.limitation: Fixture verifies single-reaction replacement, clear, reload persistence, and message retention; no concurrent-device sync.

rows.limitation: Fixture verifies single-reaction replacement, clear, reload persistence, and message retention; no concurrent-device sync.

rows.acceptance: New user can start a named conversation without understanding teams. Existing chats, drafts, queues and avatars remain accessible.

checks.name: coworker-first entry keeps direct chats, queue, grouped history, and avatar access reachable
checks.limitation: Fixture verifies direct/grouped history, queue, and avatar reachability; no user-study evidence.

rows.limitation: Fixture verifies direct/grouped history, queue, and avatar reachability; no user-study evidence.

rows.acceptance: Short first message never replaces coworker identity.

checks.name: short sent message retains selected coworker header
checks.limitation: Fixture verifies local send preserves the selected header and request identity; provider execution is blocked.

rows.limitation: Fixture verifies local send preserves the selected header and request identity; provider execution is blocked.

rows.acceptance: Markdown table syntax and code fences do not overwhelm the row. Full title remains accessible.

checks.name: plain preview and full duplicate title remain accessible at narrow width
checks.limitation: Fixture verifies 390px previews, duplicate titles, and horizontal containment; no full responsive breakpoint matrix.

rows.limitation: Fixture verifies 390px previews, duplicate titles, and horizontal containment; no full responsive breakpoint matrix.

rows.acceptance: Pinned items remain accessible and retain order after reload.

checks.name: multiple pinned conversations retain exact order and access after reload
checks.limitation: Fixture verifies two pinned rows retain exact order and access after reload; no cross-device sync.

rows.limitation: Fixture verifies two pinned rows retain exact order and access after reload; no cross-device sync.

rows.acceptance: Renaming a conversation never renames its coworker unexpectedly.

checks.name: conversation rename leaves coworker identity unchanged through navigation
checks.limitation: Fixture verifies conversation rename keeps coworker identity through navigation; local fixture only.

rows.limitation: Fixture verifies conversation rename keeps coworker identity through navigation; local fixture only.

rows.acceptance: Grouping never implies coordinated agent execution or hides old histories.

checks.name: direct and grouped histories stay distinct and old grouped chat remains discoverable
checks.limitation: Fixture verifies direct/grouped histories remain distinct and old grouped rows remain reachable; no user interpretation study.

rows.limitation: Fixture verifies direct/grouped histories remain distinct and old grouped rows remain reachable; no user interpretation study.

rows.acceptance: Collapse and resize leave active chat and composer usable.

checks.name: resize and collapse preserve active chat and composer usability
checks.limitation: Fixture verifies mouse resize, Home-key resize, collapse, and composer editing; no assistive-technology certification.

rows.limitation: Fixture verifies mouse resize, Home-key resize, collapse, and composer editing; no assistive-technology certification.

rows.acceptance: Back returns to previous chat without dropping draft or executing a request.

checks.name: back and forward preserve drafts without sending or executing
checks.limitation: Fixture verifies back/forward draft restoration and zero chat API calls; local session history only.

rows.limitation: Fixture verifies back/forward draft restoration and zero chat API calls; local session history only.

rows.acceptance: Known saved phrase resolves to the correct conversation.

checks.name: known search result opens the exact conversation
checks.limitation: Fixture verifies a known phrase opens exact message m3 and focuses it; search index is local fixture data.

rows.limitation: Fixture verifies a known phrase opens exact message m3 and focuses it; search index is local fixture data.

rows.acceptance: Filter by coworker or conversation and open exact result context.

checks.name: coworker and conversation filters open exact duplicate-term context
checks.limitation: Fixture verifies coworker and conversation filters return exact result d1 and focus it; no external index.

rows.limitation: Fixture verifies coworker and conversation filters return exact result d1 and focus it; no external index.

rows.acceptance: Searching a repeated term visits every match without losing composer draft.

checks.name: find next and previous visit every match while preserving draft
checks.limitation: Fixture verifies four local matches cycle with next/previous while preserving the draft; no cross-conversation find scope.

rows.limitation: Fixture verifies four local matches cycle with next/previous while preserving the draft; no cross-conversation find scope.

rows.acceptance: Keyboard opens palette; selected action works in current chat; Escape restores focus.

checks.name: keyboard opens palette, runs current-chat action, and Escape restores focus
checks.limitation: Fixture verifies Ctrl+K, keyboard result navigation, action execution, and Escape focus restoration; no OS-level shortcut conflicts.

rows.limitation: Fixture verifies Ctrl+K, keyboard result navigation, action execution, and Escape focus restoration; no OS-level shortcut conflicts.

rows.acceptance: Reply identifies source message; cancel removes reference without deleting draft.

checks.name: reply identifies source and cancel keeps draft
checks.limitation: Fixture verifies reply source identification and cancel preserving the draft; local fixture only.

rows.limitation: Fixture verifies reply source identification and cancel preserving the draft; local fixture only.

rows.acceptance: Representative network reports remain readable; untrusted HTML cannot execute.

checks.name: safe markdown is readable and unsafe HTML/schemes stay inert
checks.limitation: Fixture verifies table/code-fence readability and safe-link/unsafe-HTML inertness; no broader sanitizer fuzzing.

rows.limitation: Fixture verifies table/code-fence readability and safe-link/unsafe-HTML inertness; no broader sanitizer fuzzing.

rows.acceptance: Spaces, tabs and line breaks survive copy; no duplicate raw output.

checks.name: CLI output renders once and copy preserves whitespace
checks.limitation: Fixture verifies one CLI output render and exact whitespace clipboard content; clipboard is isolated in Chromium.

rows.limitation: Fixture verifies one CLI output render and exact whitespace clipboard content; clipboard is isolated in Chromium.

rows.acceptance: Copy uses correct message and reports failure without claiming success.

checks.name: message copy selects the correct text and truthfully reports denial
checks.limitation: Fixture verifies correct message copy and denied-clipboard Copy failed feedback; clipboard is intercepted in isolated Chromium.

rows.limitation: Fixture verifies correct message copy and denied-clipboard Copy failed feedback; clipboard is intercepted in isolated Chromium.

rows.acceptance: Old and new days are clear; full timestamp accessible on focus or hover.

checks.name: old/new date groups and accessible full timestamps are visible
checks.limitation: Fixture verifies old/new date groups and focused full timestamp labels; timezone presentation is limited to this environment.

rows.limitation: Fixture verifies old/new date groups and focused full timestamp labels; timezone presentation is limited to this environment.

rows.acceptance: New output does not pull user away from an older message; latest button is keyboard usable.

checks.name: new output keeps older reading position and latest control is keyboard usable
checks.limitation: Fixture verifies older reading position, new output, and keyboard latest control; local fixture run only.

rows.limitation: Fixture verifies older reading position, new output, and keyboard latest control; local fixture run only.

rows.acceptance: Revert and undo restore exact message history; busy or queued state is protected.

checks.name: revert and undo restore byte-equivalent history and protect queued work
checks.limitation: Fixture verifies deep-equal revert/undo history and queued-work protection; no provider busy race.

rows.limitation: Fixture verifies deep-equal revert/undo history and queued-work protection; no provider busy race.

rows.acceptance: Branch retains provenance and can be revisited without mutating parent history.

checks.name: fork preserves provenance, parent history, and reload revisit
checks.limitation: Fixture verifies fork provenance, parent immutability, and reload revisit; no cross-device history sync.

rows.limitation: Fixture verifies fork provenance, parent immutability, and reload revisit; no cross-device history sync.

rows.acceptance: Link opens correct conversation/message; missing or archived targets have a clear explanation.

checks.name: existing, missing, and archived message links explain their destination
checks.limitation: Fixture verifies existing, missing, and archived local hash links and explanations; local URL handling only.

rows.limitation: Fixture verifies existing, missing, and archived local hash links and explanations; local URL handling only.

rows.acceptance: Picker supports search/navigation and closes without moving the message.

checks.name: more-reactions picker navigates, dismisses, and exposes search
checks.limitation: Fixture verifies ten picker buttons, ArrowRight behavior, Escape dismissal, and message layout. Current v8 leaves ArrowRight outside the picker and exposes no search control, so acceptance is partial.

rows.limitation: Fixture verifies ten picker buttons, ArrowRight behavior, Escape dismissal, and message layout. Current v8 leaves ArrowRight outside the picker and exposes no search control, so acceptance is partial.

rows.acceptance: Unread state persists correctly; opening a conversation never cancels work.

checks.name: unread state persists through reload, opening clears it, and active run remains intact
checks.limitation: Fixture verifies unread toggle/reload/open and held local run journal while switching chats; provider execution is blocked.

rows.limitation: Fixture verifies unread toggle/reload/open and held local run journal while switching chats; provider execution is blocked.

rows.acceptance: Language choice never appears applied while labels remain unchanged.

checks.name: unsupported language cannot appear applied and English fallback is explicit
checks.limitation: Fixture verifies the disabled unsupported option is skipped by keyboard (English then system); no translation coverage.

rows.limitation: Fixture verifies the disabled unsupported option is skipped by keyboard (English then system); no translation coverage.
